name: Rot Hide Ichor
summary: High Executor Hadrec seeks Rot Hide Ichor in Silverpine Forest before the Forsaken attack Fenris Isle. He wants the fluid studied to understand the gnolls that infest the island.

sections.title: Unnatural Biology
sections.body: Rot Hide gnolls on Fenris Isle are decaying, aggressive, and unlike ordinary wild humanoids. They hold strategic ground across Lordamere Lake. High Executor Hadrec believes the strange fluid in their veins may explain their unnatural resilience. He needs samples before committing Forsaken soldiers to a costly assault.

sections.title: Apothecary Analysis
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society works from the Sepulcher, where Apothecary Renferrel studies biological and chemical anomalies. Bring him samples of the putrid fluid, and the Forsaken hope to learn where the gnolls came from, who is engineering them, and what weaknesses they have in battle.

faq.answer: Rot Hide Ichor is a putrid fluid that flows through the bodies of the Rot Hide gnolls on Fenris Isle. It sustains their undead-like, rotting state and gives them unusual resilience.

faq.q: Why does High Executor Hadrec want samples of the ichor?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec wants samples studied before the Forsaken assault Fenris Isle. Apothecary Renferrel may be able to trace who created the Rot Hides and find a weakness to exploit.

faq.q: Where are the Rot Hide gnolls located?
aliases: where do i find rot hides
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls live on Fenris Isle, east across Lordamere Lake from the Decrepit Ferry in Silverpine Forest. Rot Hide brutes, plague weavers, and other breeds overrun its shore, camps, and ruined grounds.

Apothecary Renferrel is a Royal Apothecary Society researcher stationed outside the crypt at the Sepulcher. He studies local blights, plagues, and strange biological hazards throughout Silverpine Forest for the Forsaken.

faq.q: What happens after Renferrel receives the ichor?
aliases: next quest after rot hide ichor
faq.answer: After receiving the samples, Renferrel analyzes the fluid's chemical makeup to trace the Rot Hides' origin. His work leads into Rot Hide Origins.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about gnolls?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls hold Fenris Isle, a vital stronghold in Lordamere Lake on the border of Forsaken territory. Their rotting condition and plague-like abilities suggest outside tampering and could threaten Undercity's security.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know that studying biological horrors and engineered diseases is part of survival. The Royal Apothecary Society examines the Rot Hides' fluid to learn whether the infection threatens Forsaken claims in Lordaeron.
As a member of the Horde, you know Fenris Isle lies on Silverpine Forest's eastern edge. Left unmonitored, it poses a tactical danger to the forces securing the surrounding lands.
